visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static close-up of a book cover titled "The Anxious Generation" by Jonathan Haidt. The cover art features a girl submerged in a sea of yellow spheres, representing digital saturation. (2) The scene cuts to two middle-aged men standing in a brightly lit exhibition hall. One man wears a green long-sleeved shirt, while the other wears a black leather jacket and glasses. They are engaged in an animated conversation with active hand gestures. (3) A red graphic overlay of a broken circle appears briefly over the man in the green shirt as they laugh. The background shows an "ITALIA" booth at a book fair with several blurred passers-by. (4) Close-up shots alternate between the two men as they discuss historical distractions. A vintage lighter graphic with a woman in a bikini is superimposed to illustrate their point about old-school media. (5) A SMPTE color bar screen with the text "Sorry, off topic" appears as a comedic reset. (6) The camera returns to the two men as they walk slowly through the crowd, concluding their discussion on desire and social media likes with wide smiles and laughter.
